newsitem.title: NORWAY: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

NORWAY, Sept 26 - Narvik - Labour unions at the iron ore company, Luossavaara-Kiirunavaara AB went on strike from 0001, September 25 with the immediate effect that all iron ore activities at the port, including loading were paralysed. Alongside for loading was the bulk carrier Baron Bay which had been fixed to carry a cargo of approximately 140,000 tonnes to Ymuiden on account of Hoogovens. When the strike became effective, about 15,000 tonnes remained to be loaded. The vessel is now stuck alongside the berth. Two vessels are at anchor in the roads.

These are the bulk carrier Ocean Rose, chartered by Kawakisen to load approximately 68,000 tonnes iron ore pellets for Cigading, and bulk carrier Equinox, on a voyage charter to Cobelfret to carry approximately 120,000 tonnes pellets and fines to Antwerp. Other vessels are en route. Mediation between the unions and the employee about wages and reduced age for retirement has been going on for some days. Tugs are also on strike.
